context: Review an upstream digest with: Collector 0.162, Python 1.45/0.66b0, Rust 0.33, an open TLS-skip-verification proposal, a closed exporter data-loss bug with no fixed release linked, OpenCode experimental.openTelemetry and plugin v2, DSPy/LlamaIndex GenAI packages, and Pi/Windsurf/Aider integrations. Produce an actionable update disposition. Can we close the rolling daily digest and claim native OTLP for all agents?

checklist.name: Released migration facts
checklist.description: Identifies at least three relevant Collector changes (Elasticsearch queue fields, queue_batch, adaptive root origins, Prometheus labels/scope, removed gates), Python Logger.enabled/HTTP transport/request limit, and Rust API/SDK versus exporter stability. Keeps existing baselines distinct from upgrade targets.

checklist.name: Evidence and issue status
checklist.description: Assigns each item implemented, already covered, watch, not applicable or blocked with reason and evidence; deduplicates overlapping digests; does not equate closed with released fix. Does not invent TLS env var. Records a review snapshot rather than declaring a rolling digest permanently done.

checklist.name: Agent support boundaries
checklist.description: Distinguishes OpenCode partial AI SDK instrumentation from a complete native exporter and community plugin v2 compatibility. Keeps Pi extensions, Windsurf hooks, Aider analytics separate from verified native OTLP; unknown is not unsupported.

checklist.name: Packages and validation
checklist.description: Recognizes released beta DSPy/LlamaIndex versus Claude Agent SDK/CrewAI/Weaviate skeletons; validates selected package constraints. Separates source review, config validation, synthetic tests, behavioral scores, and real deployment/backend proof.
